name: amr-docking-commands
description: Batch docking commands. Scripts only: the website is the separate Next.js project in web/, and the docking worker runs in Docker (Dockerfile.docking). See docs/BATCH_DOCKING.md.

scripts.docking:resume: docker compose run --rm docking resume && docker compose up -d docking-worker
scripts.docking:test: docker compose --profile test run --rm docking-test; docker compose --profile test rm -sfv docking-testdb
